param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
    [ValidateSet("InjectFault", "Detect", "Recover", "Verify")]
    [string]$Action
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$Root = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)

$StatePath = Join-Path $Root "config\simulation\incident-state.json"
$LogPath   = Join-Path $Root "logs\incident-simulation.jsonl"

if (-not (Test-Path $StatePath)) {
    throw "Incident state file not found: $StatePath"
}

$State = Get-Content $StatePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json

$Timestamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("o")

switch ($Action) {

    "InjectFault" {

        $State.incident_id = "INC-SIM-001"
        $State.scenario = "connectivity-loss"
        $State.target = "simulated-network-node"
        $State.state = "fault_injected"
        $State.simulation = $true
        $State.updated_at = $Timestamp

        $Event = @{
            timestamp = $Timestamp
            event = "FAULT_INJECTED"
            previous_state = "normal"
            new_state = "fault_injected"
            scenario = $State.scenario
            target = $State.target
            simulation = $true
        }
    }

    "Detect" {

        if ($State.state -ne "fault_injected") {
            throw "Detect requires incident state 'fault_injected'. Current state: $($State.state)"
        }

        $PreviousState = $State.state

        $State.state = "detected"
        $State.updated_at = $Timestamp

        $Event = @{
            timestamp = $Timestamp
            event = "DETECTED"
            previous_state = $PreviousState
            new_state = "detected"
            scenario = $State.scenario
            target = $State.target
            simulation = $true
            detector = "Invoke-NetworkLabIncidentSimulation.ps1"
        }
    }

    "Recover" {

        if ($State.state -ne "detected") {
            throw "Recover requires incident state 'detected'. Current state: $($State.state)"
        }

        $PreviousState = $State.state

        $State.state = "recovery"
        $State.updated_at = $Timestamp

        $Event = @{
            timestamp = $Timestamp
            event = "RECOVERY"
            previous_state = $PreviousState
            new_state = "recovery"
            scenario = $State.scenario
            target = $State.target
            simulation = $true
        }
    }

    "Verify" {

        if ($State.state -ne "recovery") {
            throw "Verify requires incident state 'recovery'. Current state: $($State.state)"
        }

        $PreviousState = $State.state

        $State.state = "verified"
        $State.updated_at = $Timestamp

        $Event = @{
            timestamp = $Timestamp
            event = "VERIFIED"
            previous_state = $PreviousState
            new_state = "verified"
            scenario = $State.scenario
            target = $State.target
            simulation = $true
        }

        # Complete lifecycle: return to NORMAL.
        $State.state = "normal"
        $State.updated_at = $Timestamp
    }
}

$State | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 |
    Set-Content -Path $StatePath -Encoding UTF8

$Event |
    ConvertTo-Json -Compress |
    Add-Content -Path $LogPath -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "==============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host " NETWORKLAB INCIDENT SIMULATION" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "==============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "Action : $Action" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "State  : $($State.state)" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Target : $($State.target)" -ForegroundColor White
Write-Host "Mode   : SIMULATION ONLY" -ForegroundColor Yellow
Write-Host "==============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
